children.text: /* @component: .more-text */(function () { function initRew() { const container = document.querySelector('.more-text'); if (!container) return; const rewSlides = [...document.querySelectorAll('.more-text')]; rewSlides.forEach((foo) => { const btn = foo.querySelector('a.more-text-link'); const span = btn.querySelector('span'); const text = foo.querySelector('.more-text-p'); const svg = btn.querySelector('.more-text-svg'); btn.addEventListener('click', (e) => { e.preventDefault(); text.classList.toggle('_is-active'); text.classList.contains('_is-active') ? span.textContent = 'Скрыть' : span.textContent = 'Читать далее'; text.classList.contains('_is-active') ? svg.style.transform = 'rotate(180deg)' : svg.style.transform = 'rotate(0deg)'; }) }) } if (document.readyState === 'loading') { document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initRew); } else { initRew(); } })();
